text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the last day of summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Over here, Sweep! Over here! I found the black cat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nice work, Kitasan! Hehe, I'm gonna give you so many pets! Yes, I am! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh, Kitasan… What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?! I thought you said you were going to give me pets!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you, some kinda dummy? You know you're not a cat, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Whew! Petting that black cat has recharged my magic, so now I'm totally prepared for the Shuka Sho!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So you're saying you feel confident about your performance in the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Autumn Shield will be mine. And after that… I will go for the Senior Autumn Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The book is already open. All that everyone needs to do is…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fill your hearts with anticipation for the heroic tale of Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Would you look at that. She's really perked up, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, come to think of it… Racing Rob Roy just might be…)
